fields.objection: SiC tube capacity uses the thermal compression envelope while line force and sleeve mass use only mechanical compression.
fields.evidence: SUPPLEMENTARY.json: 55.521 kN mechanical versus 63.974 kN compression envelope; difference 8.454 kN. This does not affect the Be-on-Be thermal comparison.
fields.proposed_fix: Build signed hot/cold equilibrium cases and propagate member forces through sleeve, bond, core-line and peel calculations. Do not combine incompatible hot-face and cold-tube envelopes as one physical load case.
fields.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed
